WITH active_charters AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    FundingType AS funding_category
  FROM schools
  WHERE Charter = 1
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
    AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
frpm_2014_15 AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    MAX(CAST("Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL)) AS enrollment_k12,
    MAX(CAST("Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS REAL)) * 100.0
      AS frpm_pct_0_100
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  GROUP BY CDSCode
),
sat_by_school AS (
  SELECT
    cds AS CDSCode,
    AVG(AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) AS combined_sat
  FROM satscores
  WHERE AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
    AND AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
    AND AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT
  a.funding_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.CDSCode) AS active_charter_schools,
  SUM(f.enrollment_k12) AS total_2014_2015_k12_enrollment,
  ROUND(AVG(f.frpm_pct_0_100), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_percent,
  ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM active_charters AS a
LEFT JOIN frpm_2014_15 AS f ON f.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN sat_by_school AS s ON s.CDSCode = a.CDSCode
GROUP BY a.funding_category
ORDER BY a.funding_category;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.School AS school_name,
    f."Low Grade" AS earliest_grade,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS k12_enrollment,
    COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools'
    AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
)
SELECT school_name, earliest_grade, k12_enrollment, sat_test_takers
FROM candidates
ORDER BY
  CASE earliest_grade
    WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1
    WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 4
    WHEN '4' THEN 5 WHEN '5' THEN 6 WHEN '6' THEN 7
    WHEN '7' THEN 8 WHEN '8' THEN 9 WHEN '9' THEN 10
    WHEN '10' THEN 11 WHEN '11' THEN 12 WHEN '12' THEN 13
    ELSE -1
  END DESC,
  k12_enrollment DESC,
  school_name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_year AS (
  SELECT MAX("Academic Year") AS academic_year
  FROM frpm
),
funding_types AS (
  SELECT 'Directly funded' AS funding_type, 'Directly funded' AS school_funding
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Locally funded only', 'Locally funded'
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT
    ft.funding_type,
    s.CDSCode,
    s.StatusType,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_k12
  FROM funding_types AS ft
  JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.FundingType = ft.school_funding
  JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  JOIN latest_year AS y
    ON f."Academic Year" = y.academic_year
  WHERE s.Charter = 1
    AND s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education'
)
SELECT
  ft.funding_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.StatusType = 'Active' THEN c.CDSCode END)
    AS currently_operating_schools,
  COALESCE(SUM(c.enrollment_k12), 0) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  COALESCE(SUM(c.frpm_k12), 0) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM funding_types AS ft
LEFT JOIN cohort AS c
  ON c.funding_type = ft.funding_type
GROUP BY ft.funding_type
ORDER BY CASE ft.funding_type
  WHEN 'Directly funded' THEN 1
  ELSE 2
END;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0
      / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate,
    sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite AS sat_total
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, 1, instr(s.GSserved, '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) <= 12
    AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) = 12
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(free_meal_rate) OVER () AS max_rate
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  printf('%.4f', free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 'No'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS charter_school,
  GSserved AS grades_served,
  CASE
    WHEN sat_total IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
    WHEN sat_total < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
    WHEN sat_total <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
    ELSE 'Above Average'
  END AS sat_performance_level
FROM ranked
WHERE free_meal_rate = max_rate
ORDER BY school_name;

treatment.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.Charter,
    s.GSserved,
    1.0 * f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate,
    CASE
      WHEN sat.cds IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrRead IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrMath IS NULL OR sat.AvgScrWrite IS NULL THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
      ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance
  FROM schools s
  JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.County = 'Alameda'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(substr(s.GSserved, instr(s.GSserved, '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) >= 12
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY free_meal_rate DESC) AS rate_rank
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  School AS school_name,
  printf('%.4f', free_meal_rate) AS free_meal_rate,
  CASE WHEN Charter = 1 THEN 'Yes' WHEN Charter = 0 THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS charter_school,
  GSserved AS grades_served,
  sat_performance AS sat_performance_level
FROM ranked
WHERE rate_rank = 1

    FROM schools

),
county_counts AS (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS virtual_school_count
    FROM virtual_schools
    GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counties AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        virtual_school_count,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY virtual_school_count DESC) AS county_rank
    FROM county_counts
),
school_scores AS (
    SELECT
        v.County,
        v.CDSCode,
        v.School,
        MAX(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_reading_score
    FROM virtual_schools AS v
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = v.CDSCode
    GROUP BY v.County, v.CDSCode, v.School
),
top_reading AS (
    SELECT
        County,
        School,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY County
            ORDER BY avg_reading_score DESC
        ) AS score_rank
    FROM school_scores
    WHERE avg_reading_score IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    c.County AS county_name,
    c.virtual_school_count,
    COALESCE(t.School, 'None') AS school_name
FROM ranked_counties AS c
LEFT JOIN top_reading AS t
    ON t.County = c.County
   AND t.score_rank = 1
WHERE c.county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY c.virtual_school_count DESC, c.County, school_name;

    FROM schools s

), county_counts AS (

    FROM ranked_counties
    WHERE county_rank <= 5
), school_scores AS (

    FROM virtual_schools v

    FROM school_scores

       tc.virtual_school_count,
       CASE WHEN ch.highest_reading IS NULL THEN 'None' ELSE ss.School END AS school_name
FROM top_counties tc
LEFT JOIN county_highs ch ON ch.County = tc.County
LEFT JOIN school_scores ss
  ON ss.County = tc.County
 AND ss.AvgScrRead = ch.highest_reading
ORDER BY tc.virtual_school_count DESC, tc.County, school_name

    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_share,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(t.NumTstTakr, 0) > 0
      THEN t.AvgScrRead + t.AvgScrMath + t.AvgScrWrite
    END AS avg_total_sat_score,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(t.NumTstTakr, 0) > 0
      THEN 100.0 * t.NumGE1500 / t.NumTstTakr
    END AS pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,
    s.OpenDate,
    CASE WHEN s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS status
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS t ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Charter = 0
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL) > 100
),
largest AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM school_metrics
  WHERE frpm_eligible_count = (
    SELECT MAX(frpm_eligible_count) FROM school_metrics
  )
),
smallest AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM school_metrics
  WHERE frpm_share = (
    SELECT MIN(frpm_share) FROM school_metrics
  )
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM school_metrics
  WHERE CDSCode = '4615150435602'
),
results AS (
  SELECT
    1 AS sort_order,
    'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part,
    School AS school_name,
    County AS county,
    City AS city,
    MailStreet AS mailing_street,
    MailCity AS mailing_city,
    MailState AS mailing_state,
    MailZip AS mailing_ZIP,
    Website AS website,
    k12_enrollment,
    frpm_eligible_count,
    frpm_share,
    avg_total_sat_score,
    pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,
    OpenDate AS opening_date,
    status
  FROM largest

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    2,
    'smallest FRPM share',
    School,
    County,
    City,
    MailStreet,
    MailCity,
    MailState,
    MailZip,
    Website,
    k12_enrollment,
    frpm_eligible_count,
    frpm_share,
    avg_total_sat_score,
    pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,
    OpenDate,
    status
  FROM smallest

  SELECT
    3,
    'the CDS code from my notes',
    School,
    County,
    City,
    MailStreet,
    MailCity,
    MailState,
    MailZip,
    Website,
    k12_enrollment,
    frpm_eligible_count,
    frpm_share,
    avg_total_sat_score,
    pct_sat_takers_1500_plus,
    OpenDate,
    status
  FROM benchmark
)
SELECT
  part,
  school_name,
  county,
  city,
  mailing_street,
  mailing_city,
  mailing_state,
  mailing_ZIP,

  JOIN district d
    ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'F'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM card ca
      WHERE ca.disp_id = owner_disp.disp_id
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan l
      WHERE l.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
    )
),
regional_averages AS (
  SELECT region,
         ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS avg_district_salary,
         ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996), 2) AS avg_unemployment_1996
  FROM qualifying_clients
  GROUP BY region
),
districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         qc.region,
         qc.district_id,
         qc.population,
         d.A2 AS district_name
  FROM qualifying_clients qc
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = qc.district_id
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT region,
         district_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY region
           ORDER BY population DESC, district_name ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM districts
)
SELECT ra.region,
       ra.avg_district_salary,
       ra.avg_unemployment_1996,
       rd.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM regional_averages ra
JOIN ranked_districts rd
  ON rd.region = ra.region
 AND rd.rn = 1
ORDER BY ra.region;

WITH district_crimes AS (
    SELECT A2 AS district_name, A3 AS region, A4 AS inhabitants, A16 AS crimes_1996
    FROM district
),
ranked_central_bohemia AS (
    SELECT
        district_name,
        inhabitants,
        crimes_1996,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, lower(district_name) COLLATE BINARY ASC
        ) AS rank
    FROM district_crimes
    WHERE region = 'central Bohemia'
),
averages AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(CAST(crimes_1996 AS REAL)) AS overall_average,
        AVG(CASE WHEN region = 'central Bohemia' AND central_rank <= 3
                 THEN CAST(crimes_1996 AS REAL) END) AS three_district_average
    FROM (
        SELECT
            district_crimes.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY region
                ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, lower(district_name) COLLATE BINARY ASC
            ) AS central_rank
        FROM district_crimes
    ) AS ranked_districts
)
SELECT
    r.rank,
    r.district_name,
    r.inhabitants,
    r.crimes_1996,
    ROUND(a.three_district_average, 2) AS three_district_average,
    ROUND(a.overall_average, 2) AS all_districts_average,
    ROUND(a.three_district_average - a.overall_average, 2) AS difference
FROM ranked_central_bohemia AS r
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE r.rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.rank;

WITH district_card_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.type AS card_type, cl.district_id

  WHERE lower(c.type) IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT
    dch.card_type,
    d.A2 AS home_district,
    d.A8 AS inhabitants,

      PARTITION BY dch.card_type
      ORDER BY d.A8
    ) AS inhabitants_rank
  FROM district_card_holders AS dch
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = dch.district_id
)
SELECT card_type, home_district, inhabitants
FROM ranked_districts
WHERE inhabitants_rank = 1
ORDER BY card_type, home_district;

WITH target_region AS (
  SELECT A3 AS region
  FROM district
  WHERE A2 = 'Litomerice'
),
opened_accounts AS (
  SELECT account_id, district_id
  FROM account
  WHERE date >= '1996-01-01'
    AND date < '1997-01-01'
),
ranked_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    t.account_id,
    t.balance,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY t.account_id
      ORDER BY t.date DESC, t.trans_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN opened_accounts AS oa ON oa.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.date < '1997-01-01'
),
account_balances AS (
  SELECT oa.account_id, oa.district_id, rt.balance
  FROM opened_accounts AS oa
  JOIN ranked_transactions AS rt
    ON rt.account_id = oa.account_id AND rt.rn = 1
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = oa.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 = (SELECT region FROM target_region)
),
district_stats AS (
  SELECT
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    ROUND(AVG(ab.balance), 2) AS average_end_1996_balance,
    AVG(ab.balance) AS average_raw
  FROM account_balances AS ab
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ab.district_id
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT ROUND(AVG(balance), 2) AS region_average
  FROM account_balances
),
top_district AS (
  SELECT district_name, average_end_1996_balance
  FROM district_stats
  ORDER BY average_raw DESC, district_name ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  'DISTRICT' AS row_type,
  district_name,
  account_count,
  average_end_1996_balance,
  NULL AS region_average,
  NULL AS highest_average_district
FROM district_stats

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'REGION_AVERAGE',
  NULL,
  NULL,
  NULL,
  region_average,
  NULL
FROM region_stats

UNION ALL

SELECT
  'HIGHEST_DISTRICT',
  district_name,
  NULL,
  average_end_1996_balance,
  NULL,
  district_name
FROM top_district
ORDER BY row_type, district_name;

WITH ranked_loans AS (

  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_order_by_district AS (
  SELECT a.district_id, SUM(o.amount) AS total_standing_order_debit
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN "order" AS o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.district_id
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT d.district_id,
         d.A2 AS district_name,
         d.A3 AS region,
         d.A4 AS population,
         w.total_amount_withdrawn,
         1.0 * w.total_amount_withdrawn / d.A4 AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
         1.0 * COALESCE(s.total_standing_order_debit, 0)
             / COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN district_withdrawals AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
  JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  LEFT JOIN standing_order_by_district AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2, d.A3, d.A4,
           w.total_amount_withdrawn, s.total_standing_order_debit

       ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_pressure_rank,
       ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2)
         AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account

ORDER BY withdrawal_pressure_rank, district_name;

    FROM trans

SELECT

    a.date AS account_opened_date,
    a.frequency,
    d.A2 AS district_name,

    CASE WHEN d.district_id = ch.home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
        AS is_client_home_district,

JOIN disp AS ca ON ca.client_id = 3541
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ca.account_id
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN region_client_counts AS rcc ON rcc.region = d.A3
JOIN district_population_ranked AS dpr ON dpr.district_id = d.district_id

           SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
    FROM trans t

district_population_ranks AS (

           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A8 DESC) AS population_rank
    FROM district d
),
most_populous AS (
    SELECT region, district_name, inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT d.A3 AS region, d.A2 AS district_name, d.A8 AS inhabitants,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3 ORDER BY d.A8 DESC, d.district_id) AS rn
        FROM district d
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT ta.account_id,
       ta.opened_date,
       ta.frequency,
       ad.A2 AS district_name,
       ad.A3 AS region,
       CASE WHEN ad.district_id = hc.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_home_district,
       ad.A11 AS average_salary,
       COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
       COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
       COALESCE(tt.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
       COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
       COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
       COALESCE(tt.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(tt.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
       COALESCE(rcc.home_client_count, 0) AS region_home_client_count,
       mp.district_name AS most_populous_district,
       mp.inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
       dpr.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank
FROM target_accounts ta
JOIN district ad ON ad.district_id = ta.account_district_id
JOIN disp p ON p.account_id = ta.account_id AND p.client_id = 3541
JOIN client hc ON hc.client_id = 3541

WITH female_loans AS (
  SELECT
    l.loan_id,
    l.account_id,
    l.amount,
    l.duration,
    l.payments,
    l.status,
    c.client_id,
    c.birth_date,
    d.A2 AS branch_district,
    d.A3 AS region
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = (
    SELECT c2.client_id
    FROM client AS c2
    WHERE c2.district_id = a.district_id
      AND c2.gender = 'F'
    ORDER BY c2.client_id
    LIMIT 1
  )
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
  FROM female_loans
),
account_transactions AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
region_loans AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS loans_granted
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_salary AS (
  SELECT A3 AS region, ROUND(AVG(A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
  FROM district
  GROUP BY A3
)
SELECT
  r.loan_id,
  r.client_id,
  r.amount AS loan_amount,
  r.duration AS duration_months,
  ROUND(r.payments * r.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND(r.payments * r.duration - r.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
  r.status AS loan_status,
  r.branch_district,
  r.region,
  COALESCE(t.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > 2.0 * r.amount THEN 'High Income'
    WHEN COALESCE(t.total_deposits, 0) > r.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
    ELSE 'Low Income'
  END AS income_category,
  rl.loans_granted AS region_loans_granted,
  rs.avg_district_salary AS region_average_salary,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%Y', r.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
    - CASE
        WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', r.birth_date)
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END AS age_on_2026_10_09
FROM ranked AS r
LEFT JOIN account_transactions AS t ON t.account_id = r.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_loans AS rl ON rl.region = r.region
LEFT JOIN region_salary AS rs ON rs.region = r.region
WHERE r.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.client_id;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT d.district_id, d.A11 AS salary
  FROM district AS d
  WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM account AS a
      WHERE a.district_id = d.district_id
        AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
        AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
        AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
    )
)
SELECT
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN qualifying_districts AS q
      ON q.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
      AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
  ) AS monthly_statement_accounts_opened_1997,
  COUNT(*) AS qualifying_districts,
  ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying_districts;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
    FROM card AS c
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
    WHERE lower(c.type) = 'gold'
),
transaction_summary AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.bank IS NOT NULL
             AND trim(t.bank) <> ''
             AND t.account IS NOT NULL
            THEN t.bank || ':' || CAST(t.account AS TEXT)
        END) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM trans AS t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_summary AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_details AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        di.A2 AS district_name,
        di.A3 AS region,
        COALESCE(ts.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(ts.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        COALESCE(ts.external_counterparty_count, 0) AS external_counterparty_count
    FROM gold_accounts AS ga
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = ga.account_id
    JOIN district AS di ON di.district_id = a.district_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_summary AS ts ON ts.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_summary AS ls ON ls.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    loan_count,
    external_counterparty_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparty_count DESC) AS counterparty_rank
FROM account_details
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, account_id;

WITH tabor AS (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A2 = 'Tabor'
),
account_base AS (
    SELECT a.account_id, a.date AS opened_date, c.gender, c.birth_date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN tabor AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS od ON od.account_id = a.account_id AND od.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = od.client_id
    WHERE a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT d.account_id, COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE c.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loan_summary AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_default,
           MAX(CASE WHEN status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying
    FROM loan
    WHERE date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
year_activity AS (
    SELECT account_id,
           COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'credit' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('debit', 'cash withdrawal') THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out,
           MAX(balance) AS peak_balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE date >= '1997-01-01' AND date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY account_id
),
profiles AS (
    SELECT b.account_id,
           b.opened_date,
           b.gender,
           CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
             - CAST(strftime('%Y', b.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
             - CASE
                 WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', b.birth_date)
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0
               END AS age_years,
           COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS cards_held,
           COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loans_held,
           CASE
               WHEN COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) = 0 THEN 'no loan'
               WHEN ls.has_default = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
               WHEN ls.has_repaying = 1 THEN 'repaying'
               ELSE 'paid off'
           END AS loan_standing,
           COALESCE(ya.transaction_count, 0) AS transactions_1997,
           COALESCE(ya.money_in, 0) AS money_in_1997,
           COALESCE(ya.money_out, 0) AS money_out_1997,
           COALESCE(ya.peak_balance, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM account_base AS b
    LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_summary AS ls ON ls.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN year_activity AS ya ON ya.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT account_id,
       opened_date,
       gender,
       age_years,
       cards_held,
       loans_held,
       loan_standing,
       transactions_1997,
       money_in_1997,
       money_out_1997,
       peak_balance_1997,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC) AS peak_balance_rank
FROM profiles
ORDER BY peak_balance_rank, account_id;

WITH classic_account_owners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.client_id, d.account_id, a.district_id
  FROM disp AS d
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
  WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
    AND c.type = 'classic'
),
district_clients AS (
  SELECT district_id, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS client_count
  FROM classic_account_owners
  GROUP BY district_id
),
outgoing AS (
  SELECT cao.district_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT t.bank || ':' || t.account) AS external_account_count,
         SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM classic_account_owners AS cao
  JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = cao.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cao.district_id
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(dc.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
       COALESCE(o.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
       COALESCE(o.total_amount, 0) AS total_amount
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN district_clients AS dc ON dc.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN outgoing AS o ON o.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

WITH qualifying_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverRef AS short_reference_name,
    d.nationality,
    d.dob AS birthday,
    q.q1 AS q1_time,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60.0
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS q1_seconds
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 1995
    AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
    AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q1 <> ''
    AND q.q1 <> '\N'
)
SELECT short_reference_name, nationality, birthday, q1_time
FROM qualifying_times
WHERE q1_seconds = (SELECT MAX(q1_seconds) FROM qualifying_times)
ORDER BY short_reference_name;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    q.q1,
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q1_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 1995
    AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
    AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q1 <> '\N'
)
SELECT forename, surname, q1 AS q1_time
FROM parsed
WHERE q1_ms = (SELECT MIN(q1_ms) FROM parsed)
ORDER BY surname, forename;

WITH q1_times AS (
  SELECT d.forename, d.surname, q.q1,
         MIN(
           CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
           + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
           + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 4, 3) AS INTEGER)
         ) OVER () AS fastest_ms,
         CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
           + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
           + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 4, 3) AS INTEGER) AS q1_ms
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 1995
    AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
    AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q1 <> ''
)
SELECT forename, surname, q1 AS q1_time
FROM q1_times
WHERE q1_ms = fastest_ms
LIMIT 1000;

WITH chinese_editions AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, time
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
    AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    AND time IS NOT NULL
),
earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(time) AS start_time
  FROM chinese_editions
),
selected AS (
  SELECT c.raceId, c.year, c.time
  FROM chinese_editions AS c
  JOIN earliest AS e ON c.time = e.start_time
  ORDER BY c.year DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.year AS season_year,
       s.time AS scheduled_local_start_time,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS runner_up,
       r.time AS runner_up_time_gap
FROM selected AS s
JOIN results AS r
  ON r.raceId = s.raceId
 AND r.positionOrder = 2
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = r.driverId;

WITH chinese_gp AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, r.year, r.time AS scheduled_time
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE c.country = 'China'
    AND r.name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
    AND r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    AND r.time IS NOT NULL
), earliest AS (
  SELECT MIN(scheduled_time) AS min_time
  FROM chinese_gp
), selected_race AS (
  SELECT g.*
  FROM chinese_gp g
  JOIN earliest e ON g.scheduled_time = e.min_time
  ORDER BY g.year DESC
  LIMIT 1
), finish AS (
  SELECT sr.year, sr.scheduled_time,
         MAX(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder = 1 THEN d.forename || ' ' || d.surname END) AS winner,
         MAX(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder = 2 THEN d.forename || ' ' || d.surname END) AS runner_up,
         MAX(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder = 1 THEN res.milliseconds END) AS winner_ms,
         MAX(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder = 2 THEN res.milliseconds END) AS runner_up_ms,
         MAX(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder = 2 THEN res.time END) AS runner_up_time
  FROM selected_race sr
  JOIN results res ON res.raceId = sr.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
  WHERE res.positionOrder IN (1, 2)
  GROUP BY sr.year, sr.scheduled_time
)
SELECT year AS season_year,
       scheduled_time AS earliest_scheduled_local_start_time,
       winner,
       runner_up,
       CASE
         WHEN winner_ms IS NOT NULL AND runner_up_ms IS NOT NULL
           THEN printf('+%.3f seconds', (runner_up_ms - winner_ms) / 1000.0)
         ELSE runner_up_time
       END AS runner_up_time_gap
FROM finish;

WITH start_times AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitRef,
    CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS start_seconds
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND length(r.time) >= 8
),
extrema AS (
  SELECT
    MIN(start_seconds) AS earliest_seconds,
    MAX(start_seconds) AS latest_seconds
  FROM start_times
)
SELECT
  'earliest' AS which,
  s.circuitRef,
  s.start_seconds,
  e.latest_seconds - e.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM start_times AS s
CROSS JOIN extrema AS e
WHERE s.start_seconds = e.earliest_seconds
UNION ALL
SELECT
  'latest' AS which,
  s.circuitRef,
  s.start_seconds,
  e.latest_seconds - e.earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM start_times AS s
CROSS JOIN extrema AS e
WHERE s.start_seconds = e.latest_seconds
ORDER BY which, circuitRef;

treatment.sql:
WITH start_times AS (
  SELECT c.circuitRef,
         CAST(substr(r.time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60
         + CAST(substr(r.time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds_after_midnight
  FROM races r
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
    AND length(r.time) >= 8
), extrema AS (
  SELECT MIN(seconds_after_midnight) AS earliest_seconds,
         MAX(seconds_after_midnight) AS latest_seconds
  FROM start_times
), boundary_refs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT st.circuitRef, st.seconds_after_midnight
  FROM start_times st
)
SELECT 'earliest' AS boundary,
       group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') AS circuit_refs,
       earliest_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
       latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM boundary_refs, extrema
WHERE seconds_after_midnight = earliest_seconds
GROUP BY earliest_seconds, latest_seconds
UNION ALL
SELECT 'latest' AS boundary,
       group_concat(circuitRef, ', ') AS circuit_refs,
       latest_seconds AS start_time_seconds,
       latest_seconds - earliest_seconds AS gap_seconds
FROM boundary_refs, extrema
WHERE seconds_after_midnight = latest_seconds
GROUP BY earliest_seconds, latest_seconds;

WITH ece_college AS (

  FROM major
  WHERE lower(department) LIKE '%electrical%computer%engineering%'
     OR lower(major_name) LIKE '%electrical%computer%engineering%'
  LIMIT 1
),
college_departments AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT department
  FROM major
  WHERE college = (SELECT college FROM ece_college)
),
attended_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_member
  FROM attendance
),
department_dues AS (
  SELECT m.major_id, SUM(i.amount) AS dues_total
  FROM major m
  JOIN member mb ON mb.link_to_major = m.major_id
  JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = mb.member_id
  WHERE mb.position = 'Member'
    AND i.source = 'Dues'
    AND mb.member_id IN (SELECT link_to_member FROM attended_members)
  GROUP BY m.major_id
)
SELECT cd.department,
       COALESCE(SUM(dd.dues_total), 0) AS total_dues_dollars
FROM college_departments cd
LEFT JOIN major m
  ON m.department = cd.department
 AND m.college = (SELECT college FROM ece_college)
LEFT JOIN department_dues dd ON dd.major_id = m.major_id
GROUP BY cd.department
ORDER BY cd.department;

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event AS event_id

),
item_text AS (
  SELECT e.expense_description
  FROM expense e
  JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget

  WHERE e.expense_description IS NOT NULL
),
split_items AS (
  SELECT
    trim(substr(expense_description, 1, instr(expense_description || ',', ',') - 1)) AS item,
    CASE
      WHEN instr(expense_description, ',') > 0
      THEN substr(expense_description, instr(expense_description, ',') + 1)
      ELSE ''
    END AS rest
  FROM item_text
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    trim(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest || ',', ',') - 1)),
    CASE WHEN instr(rest, ',') > 0 THEN substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1) ELSE '' END
  FROM split_items
  WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lower(item)) AS kind_count
FROM split_items

FROM atom AS y
JOIN atom AS h_mol ON h_mol.molecule_id = y.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = h_mol.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = h_mol.atom_id
JOIN atom AS endpoint1 ON endpoint1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom AS endpoint2 ON endpoint2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE y.element = 'Y'
  AND h_mol.element = 'H'
  AND (endpoint1.element = 'H' OR endpoint2.element = 'H');

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
pair_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a1.element <= a2.element
        THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  bc.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
  bc.bond_count,
  COALESCE(pc.element_pair_count, 0) AS element_pair_count,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_counts bc
LEFT JOIN pair_counts pc ON pc.bond_type = bc.bond_type
CROSS JOIN molecule m
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bc.bond_count DESC, bc.bond_type ASC;

WITH bond_profile AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind_symbol,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || '-' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '-' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM bond b
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR377'
    AND b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  bp.bond_kind_symbol,
  bp.bond_count,
  bp.element_pair_count,
  m.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_profile bp
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = 'TR377'
ORDER BY bp.bond_count DESC, bp.bond_kind_symbol ASC

baseline.sql:
WITH bond_counts AS (
    SELECT
        c.atom_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        c.atom_id2 AS atom_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM connected AS c
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    GROUP BY c.atom_id2
),
atom_bond_totals AS (
    SELECT
        atom_id,
        SUM(total_bonds) AS total_bonds,
        SUM(single_bonds) AS single_bonds,
        SUM(multiple_bonds) AS multiple_bonds
    FROM bond_counts
    GROUP BY atom_id
)
SELECT
    a.element AS element_symbol,
    COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN atom_bond_totals AS t ON t.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE t.total_bonds > 0
  AND t.single_bonds = t.total_bonds
  AND t.multiple_bonds = 0
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
